gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai sets words as solid blocks, with generous space between each curve's end and its stem, so it feels approachable. Dogica's heavy, wide-spaced display letters shout while the sans murmurs.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Heavy and wide-spaced, Dogica keeps its lowercase near capital height and leaves every curve open. Noto Sans Vithkuqi stays clean and modern, with open throats and hardly any step from capital to lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Dogica's wide tracking gives its heavy, capital-tall lowercase a commanding stride. Noto Sans Wancho counters with a hulking, chalky lowercase and an e with a wide gap at its terminal.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Words in Noto Sans Warang Citi land as solid blocks, clean and contemporary. Dogica is best at heavy, commanding display lines, while the sans is best at wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-yi: Dogica's lowercase climbs nearly to capital height, wide-tracked and heavy. Where Dogica is best at commanding attention, Noto Sans Yi is best at modern, professional text, its deep midsection and unlatched rounds doing the work.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Tiny sizes stay crisp in Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, thanks to wide gaps. Next to Dogica's heavy, commanding, wide-set bulk, that body's soaring x-height feels approachable and contemporary, almost breezy.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-traditional-nu: Dogica sets its lowercase nearly at capital height, heavy and widely tracked, with every curve left open. Noto Traditional Nushu feels softer beside it, a broad-nibbed sans whose strokes never curl shut.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-numans: Dogica is heavy and wide-tracked, its lowercase rising close to capitals, every curve left open at the end. Dogica is best at commanding; Numans is best at staying modern and clean.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-onest: Dogica hits hard, wide-tracked with a lowercase that nearly matches its capitals and curves left open at every end. Onest is the sans-serif that settles in, short ascenders over big bowls.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smooth, with no clogged curves anywhere on the line. What stands out most is the jump from Dogica's heavy, wide-tracked display letters to the bulky, modern sans-serif lowercase.
